mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.devicename, d.datatablename, s.id AS site_id, s.name AS site_name, im.id AS mppt_id, im.name AS mppt_name, mpm.id_parameter AS mppt_parameter_id, mpm.parameter_type AS mppt_parameter_type, dp1.slug AS mppt_parameter_slug, dp1.name AS mppt_parameter_name, ms.id AS string_id, ms.name AS string_name, spm.id_parameter AS string_parameter_id, spm.parameter_type AS string_parameter_type, dp2.slug AS string_parameter_slug, dp2.name AS string_parameter_name FROM inverter_mppt im JOIN site s ON s.id = im.id_site JOIN device d ON d.id = im.id_device LEFT JOIN mppt_parameter_map mpm ON mpm.id_mppt = im.id LEFT JOIN device_parameters dp1 ON mpm.id_parameter = dp1.id JOIN mppt_string ms ON ms.id_mppt = im.id LEFT JOIN string_parameter_map spm ON spm.id_string = ms.id LEFT JOIN device_parameters dp2 ON spm.id_parameter = dp2.id WHERE SHA1(s.id) = #{hash_id_site} ORDER BY d.id, im.id, ms.id
